brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Threatened miscarriage, recurrent pregnancy loss, luteal phase support in ART, dysmenorrhea, progesterone deficiency.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Orally active progestogen with high affinity for progesterone receptors; supports endometrial maturation and gestation without androgenic side effects.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 10 mg to 40 mg daily depending on clinical indication. Maintains pregnancy without suppressing ovulation at standard doses.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Maternal nutritional support, preconception optimization, prevention of pregnancy-related vitamin deficiencies.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Provides essential micronutrients to support maternal metabolic demand, cellular differentiation, and fetal tissue development.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 1 tablet daily with meals. Essential for satisfying elevated daily dietary requirements during gestation.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Treatment of susceptible urinary tract infections (UTIs) and lower respiratory tract infections.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Sequential dual-blockade of bacterial folic acid synthesis via inhibition of dihydropteroate synthase and dihydrofolate reductase.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 1 double-strength (800/160 mg) tablet BID. Use caution in 1st trimester (folate antagonist) and late 3rd trimester (kernicterus risk).

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Comprehensive prenatal and postnatal nutritional support, prevention of neural tube defects and maternal anemia.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Delivers core micronutrients including Folic Acid, Iron, Calcium, and Zinc to support embryonic development and maternal blood expansion.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 1 capsule daily post-meal. High-folate prenatal complex critical for early neural fold closure.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Gestational hypertension, preeclampsia management, chronic hypertension in pregnancy.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Centrally acting alpha-2 adrenergic receptor agonist; decreases sympathetic outflow to lower peripheral vascular resistance and blood pressure.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 250 mg to 500 mg BID/TID (max 3 g/day). First-line antihypertensive with long-standing safety profiles in fetal outcomes.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) management, surgical bleeding control during cesarean delivery, severe menorrhagia.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Competitive antifibrinolytic; binds plasminogen lysine sites to block plasmin binding and prevent fibrin degradation.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 1 g IV over 10 mins within 3 hours of PPH onset. Can repeat once after 30 mins if bleeding persists.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), Chlamydia trachomatis in pregnancy, penicillin-allergic patients.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Macrolide antibiotic; reversibly binds the 50S ribosomal subunit to inhibit bacterial protein synthesis.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 250 mg to 500 mg QID. Standard component of PPROM latency antibiotic protocols.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Iron deficiency anemia of pregnancy, expansion of maternal red cell mass, post-hemorrhage recovery.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Provides essential elemental iron required for hemoglobin synthesis and oxygen transport to fetal tissues.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 60 mg to 120 mg elemental iron daily on an empty stomach with Vitamin C to maximize intestinal absorption.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Maternal epilepsy management, trigeminal neuralgia during pregnancy.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Use-dependent voltage-gated sodium channel blocker; stabilizes hyperexcitable neuronal membranes and suppresses repetitive firing.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 125 mg BID titrated as needed. Co-administer high-dose Folic Acid (5 mg/day) and monitor maternal serum drug levels.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Generalized tonic-clonic seizures, focal epilepsy management in obstetric patients.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Sustains inactivation of voltage-gated sodium channels to control neuronal synchronization and seizure spread.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 250 mg BID/TID. Requires maternal VK1 supplementation near delivery to lower neonatal hemorrhagic risk.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Induction and augmentation of labor, prevention and treatment of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH).
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Binds G-protein coupled oxytocin receptors in myometrium, increasing intracellular calcium and triggering uterine contractions.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: Labor induction: IV infusion starting at 1-2 mU/min. PPH prevention: 10 units IM or slow IV drip post-delivery.
